name: Tôm sú
summary: Tôm sú is sold by the kilogram on the harbor streets in large and small sizes, with tôm sú biển as its own line.
howToEat: Order it by weight. Island seafood is at its best in winter, before the spring spawn.
where: Đường 1/4 and đường Núi Ngọc, the two seafood streets of Cát Bà town.
